title: Heat and temperature (part 5)
textbookText: Importance of Absolute Zero Temperature: Temperature of a body is directly proportional to the kinetic energy of its molecules. Absolute temperature becomes zero only for the zero kinetic energy of molecules. For zero kinetic energy, velocity of all molecules must be zero. This means at absolute zero temperature molecules of a body are completely at rest.

Q. Fahrenheit thermometer reads 99.0 when a standard centigrade thermometer reads 37.0. Find error in the Fahrenheit scale.

Solution: Here, Fahrenheit thermometer reading = 99.0F Standard centigrade thermometer reading = 37.0C Temperature equivalent to 37C when measured in Fahrenheit scale is given by C – 0 F-32.0 100 = 180 or, 37.0 = F-32.0 100 180 9 or, F = 5 (37.0) + 32.0 = 98.6 F Therefore, Error in Fahrenheit scale = (99.0 – 98.6)F = 0.4F
